subject: [PATCH v6 09/12] mm: handle PMD swap entries in UFFDIO_MOVE

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch adds support for moving PMD swap entries in the UFFDIO_MOVE operation. It introduces a new function `move_swap_pmd()` that moves the swap entry whole-PMD and re-anchors a PMD-sized swap-cache folio's anon rmap to the destination VMA. The patch also includes changes to handle PMD swap entries in the `move_pages_huge_pmd()` function, which was previously returning -ENOENT for non-trans_huge, non-migration PMDs. The patch preserves UFFDIO_MOVE's single-owner semantics and propagates soft-dirty flags. It also adds checks to prevent moving a PMD swap entry at the destination with -EEXIST.
